_declared: BOTH-CLASS variant of configs/detection_rule_recal.json, calibrated 2026-08-05 on the SAME 600-run null (seed block 950000+, configuration c=1.0 / white / mid / MNAR) that amendment A-8 used. The ONLY difference from the recalibrated rule is leading.classes = [obs_formation, obs_escalation]; the lagging comparator is inherited verbatim. The leading threshold is re-picked by the frozen A-2/A-8 procedure -- smallest k on the 0.25-step grid with calibration null FPR <= 3.5% -- because adding a class changes the null distribution of the composite score. See spec section 9 amendment A-11.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles
